plain.li: The council gave me "{WISH}", and now it's gone again. Nobody said a word to me about it.
I had it for {DAYS}. I'm writing that down, because they seem to have forgotten.
Crossed "{WISH}" off this page when I got it. Now I'm writing it back in.
[kept:ownroom] They put me back in with the others today. I had that room for {DAYS}.
[kept:ownroom] My room isn't just mine any more. I'm sharing again, and I wasn't asked first.
[kept:ownroom, winter] Back in shared quarters, in the middle of winter. More breathing in the dark, less sleep.
[kept:room] My room isn't what it was when they gave it to me. I keep looking at the empty corner.
[kept:bed] The bed they gave us isn't ours any more. I'd only just got used to it.
[kept:thing] It stood there for {DAYS}. Then one morning it was gone, and nobody would say why.
[kept:stock] The stores they filled for me are nearly empty again, and nobody seems in a hurry.
[kept:assignment] They let me do what I asked for {DAYS}, and then quietly changed it back.
[kept:pet] I'd only just learned all its habits. Now someone else will.
[kept:decree] I asked the council for that decree, and they lifted it before its time.

warm.li: I suppose it was needed somewhere else. I wish someone had told me.
[kept:ownroom] I suppose the room was needed for someone. I still miss it.
[kept:pet] I keep saving scraps from supper out of habit. There's nobody to give them to.

blunt.li: They gave it and they took it back. I won't forget that.
[kept:ownroom] They gave me a room and took it back. I won't forget that.
[kept:assignment] Gave me the work I wanted, then took it off me again. Make up your minds.

cheerful.li: Easy come, easy go, I suppose. I did enjoy it while it lasted.
[kept:ownroom] Out of my room and back with the others. At least the card games are closer now.

gloomy.li: Of course it didn't last. Nothing given here ever does.
[kept:ownroom] I knew the room wouldn't last. Back to the snoring.
[kept:stock] Full shelves for {DAYS}, and now we're back to scraping.

cold.li: "{WISH}": granted, then withdrawn. Noted, with the date.
[kept:ownroom] My private quarters were reassigned. I'll remember who decided that.
[kept:decree] The council's word lasted exactly as long as it was convenient.

plain.li: It's back: "{WISH}". Someone must have heard me. I'll let it go.
They put it right. I'm crossing out what I wrote the other day.
[kept:ownroom] My room is mine again. I slept with the door shut and didn't wake once.
[kept:pet] Back where it belongs, curled up by my feet as if it never left.
[kept:assignment] They've let me get back to it. I didn't know how much I'd missed it until today.

warm.li: They made it right, and quickly. That matters more to me than the thing itself.

blunt.li: It's back. Good. Don't do that again.

cheerful.li: It's back. I'll pretend it was all a misunderstanding. Maybe it even was.

gloomy.li: They put it back. For now, anyway.

cold.li: Restored. The council corrected its mistake. I'll keep the earlier entry anyway.

plain.li: You gave me this once already.
I had it, and then I didn't. I'd like it back.
I'm asking again for something I already had.

warm.li: I know there must have been a reason it went. I'd still like it back, if it can be done.

blunt.li: You took it away. Now give it back.

cheerful.li: Remember when I had this? Good times. Could we have them again?

gloomy.li: I don't expect it to last this time either, but I'm asking.

cold.li: The council granted this before, and then went back on it. I'm giving it a second chance.
